use_case: Generative AI assistant integrated in the enclave collaboration suite: search, summarize, and draft text from CUI engineering documents (specifications, change requests, work instruction drafts, quality reports)
vendor_or_model: Government-community cloud provider's integrated generative AI assistant (large language model add-on to SYS-02)
data_categories: CUI: controlled technical information, ITAR and EAR technical data in prompts, retrieved files, and outputs
consequential_decision_category: None directly; escalates to Safety if outputs are used for dimensions, tolerances, NC programs, build parameters, or inspection criteria
human_in_the_loop: A qualified engineer reviews every output; engineering release still requires checker sign-off; outputs are never the source for numbers
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.204-7012(b)(2)(ii)(D) (FedRAMP Moderate-equivalent cloud); CMMC scoping 32 CFR 170.19(c) (CUI Asset); ITAR 22 CFR 120.56 and 120.54(a)(5); EAR 15 CFR 734.18(a)(5)
status: Pilot (20 users) enabled 2026-05-11 without review; disabled 2026-09-17; approved with conditions, target 2026-12-31

use_case: Machine-vision inspection of fastener presence, type, and seating on the Plant 2 assembly line; flags suspect installations for the inspector
vendor_or_model: Inspection system vendor's computer vision model (on-premises, vendor-pushed updates)
data_categories: Images of assemblies (CUI where the assembly geometry is controlled); pass and flag results
human_in_the_loop: Inspector reviews every flag; today 2% of passes are re-inspected; required: 10% re-inspection of passes and inspector sign-off on every lot
applicable_laws: Prime and Customer D quality clauses (contractual); DFARS 252.204-7012 (images are CUI where geometry is controlled); CMMC scoping 32 CFR 170.19(c) (vision cell PC is a Specialized Asset)
status: In production since 2025-11; approved with conditions

use_case: Predictive maintenance for CNC spindles: gateway streams vibration, temperature, and alarm data to the vendor's cloud model, which predicts failures
vendor_or_model: Predictive maintenance vendor (machine learning model in a commercial cloud)
data_categories: Machine telemetry; active NC program names (part numbers), which can identify controlled programs
human_in_the_loop: Maintenance planners decide on any intervention; the model only recommends
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.204-7012(b)(2)(ii)(D) (no CUI to a non-FedRAMP cloud); CMMC scoping 32 CFR 170.19(c) and DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(2); EAR and ITAR release rules if program names reveal controlled data
status: In production at Plant 1 since 2026-03; conditional: uplink off by 2026-10-31 until moved to an OT DMZ with program names removed

use_case: Corporate generative AI assistant for non-CUI work (finance, sales, HR, supply chain correspondence)
vendor_or_model: Commercial productivity suite's generative AI assistant (enterprise terms; commercial cloud)
data_categories: Corporate documents and email; must never include CUI (2 prompts with part numbers and drawing notes found in July 2026)
human_in_the_loop: Users review all output; no automated sending
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(2) and 252.204-7012 (CUI must stay in the enclave); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: In use since 2026-02 (about 400 users); approved with conditions: blocked for enclave account holders by 2026-10-31

use_case: Applicant ranking feature in the applicant tracking system: scores and orders applicants for production and engineering roles
vendor_or_model: HR SaaS vendor's ranking model (enabled by vendor default in 2026-04)
data_categories: Applicant resumes and application answers (personal information)
human_in_the_loop: Recruiters review all applicants today, but sort by the score; feature disabled 2026-09-17
applicable_laws: Title VII, 42 U.S.C. 2000e-2(k) (disparate impact); 29 CFR Part 1607 (Uniform Guidelines, used only as an internal screening indicator); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (applicant personal information)
status: Disabled 2026-09-17 (avoid); re-enable only after vendor adverse impact data and a company bias test

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots on personal or unmanaged devices
data_categories: Any; risk is CUI or customer data typed in from memory or photographed
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.204-7012 (CUI outside a covered system; possible cyber incident); ITAR 22 CFR 120.56 and 127.12; EAR 15 CFR 764.5
status: Prohibited for company data (POL-05 4.3); blocked on company networks; attestation in annual training
